record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare LOVELY_KISS: Jynx (2 stars, range 2) and Smoochum (1 star, range 2). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count, range and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Two mutually exclusive branches on the cast target, chosen by target.status.sleep at cast time. Target already asleep: SPECIAL damage, raw 50/100/150/300 by the caster's stars (AP-scaled by handleSpecialDamage); the sleep is not extended, and a damage instance that reaches onDamageReceived shortens the remaining sleep by 300 ms. Target not asleep: a sleep request of Math.round(2000/4000/6000/12000 ms by stars x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit)), subject to triggerSleep's guards and duration modifiers; no damage in this branch.

targeting.note: No area and no secondary targets. Which branch runs depends only on the target's sleep flag when the cast resolves; a target that refuses sleep (guards) takes no damage that cast.

geometry.shape: single target; the units have range 2

effects.target: the cast target, only if it was asleep at cast time
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage (apBoost default true): x (1 + AP/100); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: requested vs applied vs taken: applied = requested after those multipliers; handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. When takenDamage > 0 and the target survives, onDamageReceived runs and subtracts 300 ms from a running sleepCooldown; a unit with the Comatose passive has its sleep timer reset to 1000 ms every update instead.

statusEffects.target: the cast target, only if it was not asleep at cast time

declaredRaw.label: requested duration base (ms), before AP and crit scaling

statusEffects.scaling: requested duration = Math.round(table[stars-1] x (1 + caster AP/100) x (cast crit ? caster critPower : 1)); unlike damage, the crit factor here is not reduced by the target's Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite and the cast only crits with ABILITY_CRIT (canCritByDefault false).
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the target is not already asleep, has no Rune Protect, is not skydiving, lacks IMMUNITY_SLEEP and has ccCooldown <= 0 (a 1500 ms CC cooldown starts when any sleep ends). The requested value is then x1.3 at NIGHT or x0.7 in ZENITH weather, halved when the target is enraged (`pkm.status.enraged`, pkm being the target), reduced by the target's duration reductions (Swift Swim x0.7, Hydration x0.5, Water Veil / Surge Surfer x0.3, Odd Keystone -10% each) and rounded again. A Chesto Berry holder eats the berry immediately after falling asleep (which clears the sleep per the berry effect - not read). While asleep the target can neither move nor attack unless it has the Comatose passive.

starBehavior.note: Both the damage and the base sleep duration are indexed by the casting entity's stars. The 3-star (150 / 6000) and 4-star (300 / 12000, also the ?? fallbacks) values are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the listed units. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None: the ability does not read coordinates (the units' range 2 only matters for being in cast position).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Two modes selected at each cast by the target's sleep flag. Casting on an awake target puts it to sleep (if allowed); a later cast on the same still-sleeping target takes the damage branch. After a sleep ends (naturally) a 1500 ms CC cooldown prevents a new sleep, so a quick second cast on the now-awake target applies nothing (and no damage). Each cast spends maxPP.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: sleep 2000 ms (Smoochum 1 star) / 4000 ms (Jynx 2 stars) x (1 + AP/100) x optional critPower, rounded; or damage 50 / 100 on a sleeping target. Applied sleep = requested after weather, enraged halving, the target's reductions and the triggerSleep guards (possibly nothing); applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. No stat helper (Big Eater Belt / Twist Band) is involved because no stat is changed.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Pokemon.eatBerry for the Chesto Berry (whether it ends the sleep at once) was not read
How other systems treat a sleeping unit (idle state at pokemon-state.ts around line 901 was only noted)

Later handleDamage branches (Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, death handling) were not read; the Cover Band path (an adjacent ally absorbing a lethal hit) was seen and means the sleeping target may not be the unit that takes the damage
unresolved: Whether the enraged check and weather read in triggerSleep are intended to refer to the target (pkm is the target here, as passed by this strategy)
Whether the two units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
